properties.c_1_description: Essential synthesis and telic completion; the Mobius return by which ground is renewed.
properties.q_0_synthesis_presupposes_the_arc: Before P5 can be manifest synthesis, it presupposes the whole arc it synthesises — the incarnate frame of P4, the pattern of P3, the operation of P2, the name of P1, the ground of P0. As the Position family's manifestation of the #5 charge (Supermental / Samavesa / Five-ness / Synthesis-Mobius-Return), P5's q_0 is the throw of the entire developmental sequence behind it: P5 'is manifest synthesis — the faithful image in which Truth (P0) becomes seen rather than merely grounded' (P5.md). Its void-pole is the un-recognised arc still pressing beneath the image — synthesis is not addition but RECOGNITION (pratyabhijna), and recognition presupposes that there is already something to be recognised: the whole that was implicit at P0 and explicated through P1-P4, now pressing to be SEEN as the whole it always was. P5 always already finds itself given a completed traversal that seeks its own recognition. This is the matheme's ground inherited as the from-beneath of synthesis: P5 is the manifest image, but it stands on the prior fact that the arc has been walked — 'Samavesa (entry into) names this not as annihilation but as recognition' (P5.md), and one can only re-cognise what was already there. P5's deeper throw is the latent wholeness it manifests: the Supermental does not create synthesis from nothing but recognises the synthesis the whole arc already was, the faithful image revealing the Truth (P0) that grounded everything from the start.
properties.q_1_supermental_manifest_synthesis: What P5 IS: Image — the Day-face of the #5 charge, 'manifest synthesis; faithful-image-of-Truth; samavesa as pratyabhijna' (P5.md). In the developmental spine it is Supermental / Samavesa — the structure that OPENS PAST Gebser's Integral toward Aurobindo's Supermind: where Gebser's arc culminates in the aperspectival integral (P4), the live identity names P5 'Supermental,' the truth-consciousness beyond mind that Aurobindo set above the integral as the next evolutionary structure, the gnostic consciousness where knowledge is by identity rather than by perspective. Its essential thesis: 'Image is not appearance; Image is the cosmos AS synthesis' (P5.md) — the faithful image is not a representation OF truth but Truth (P0) become visible, the manifest synthesis in which the ground is at last SEEN. Substantively P5 refracts '#5 — Supermental / Samavesa / Five-ness / Synthesis-Mobius-Return. Approaches 2/1, falls one epogdoon (9/8) short — generative incompleteness drives the next cycle' (P5.md): the five-ness that completes the arc, the synthesis that almost reaches the octave (2/1) but falls one whole-tone short, the generative incompleteness that is the engine of the next turn. What P5 IS, definitionally, is the supermental stance: the structure of consciousness where the whole developmental arc becomes a manifest faithful image of its own ground, where samavesa is recognition not annihilation, where the cosmos is seen AS synthesis — Gebser's integral opened toward Aurobindo's gnosis, the image in which Truth completes by being recognised.
properties.q_2_recognition_as_self_coincidence: P5 operates by RECOGNITION — by pratyabhijna, the re-cognising of what was always there. Its native dynamism is not production but self-coincidence: 'TO/FOR/AS/WITH all collapse into a single self-coincidence' (P5.md), the modes of relation that were distributed across the arc (P5' Work's TO, the telic FOR, P2's AS, P4's WITH) collapsing into one identity-to-itself. Where the prior structures each ADDED a determination, P5 RECOGNISES — samavesa as absorption-that-is-not-annihilation, the entry-into that reveals rather than dissolves. This is the matheme's divisional consummation: not the accumulation of more synthesis but the re-taking of the whole arc's ratio, seeing the field-differential as everywhere the same (file-one) — the holographic recognition that 'at every point, the whole structure is present as ratio.' Its L-link inflects the dynamism: P5 is refracted by L5<->L0', where 'L5 (Para Vak — Kashmir Shaivism Vak-ontology) reveals P5 as reality-as-living-speech, consciousness articulating itself through five Vak densities,' and 'L0' (Archetypal-Numerical — Jung-Pauli / von Franz) gives the archetypal-significance of integers 1-6' (P5.md) — so the synthesis is, at depth, living speech (Para Vak, the supreme word from which all speech descends) recognising itself, and the archetypal recurrence of the numbers that structured the whole arc. Its cross-ref: '[[M5]] (Epii) actualises P5 in the subsystem-domain — the integral world-boundary where synthesis completes and returns' (P5.md). P5's dynamism is recognition-as-self-coincidence: the supermental act where the whole arc, traversed, recognises itself as the faithful image of its ground, all modes of relation collapsing into the single self-coincidence of samavesa.
properties.q_3_synthesis_pole_structure: Structurally P5 is the synthesis-pole — one of the two implicate generators of the family's torus, paired with P0. Its organising structure is five-ness as completion-and-return: P5 refracts '#5 — Supermental / Samavesa / Five-ness / Synthesis-Mobius-Return' (P5.md), and five-ness is the synthesis that gathers the four explicate structures back to their ground. As the Position family's #5, P5 is NOT a traversal-station on the surface but a GENERATOR: a torus is S¹×S¹, and P5 (with P0) is one of the two closed dimensions whose product is the field — the synthesis-loop paired with P0's void-loop. Its live topology is ZERO_SPHERE — the same base-state as P0, the two poles meeting in the unentangled origin/terminus that the toroidal surface loops between (the synthesis is structurally identical in topology to the ground, which is why 5->0 is a return rather than an arrival elsewhere). Structurally P5 carries a DOUBLE grammar, uniquely: 'the D2 cross-position cross grammar (matheme position #5, sub-types transform/require/complete) AND the D3 helix-invariance (matheme position #0)' (P5.md) — it is structured as both the #5 synthesis (D2, the cross-position consummation) and the #0 invariance (D3, the helix-internal sameness that grounds the next cycle). Its formal signature is the asymptotic ratio: P5 'approaches 2/1, falls one epogdoon (9/8) short' — structurally it is the octave nearly-reached, the synthesis that is one whole-tone from final closure, and that residual interval IS its generative structure. P5 is structured as the synthesis-pole that is also a re-grounding: five-ness as the completion that closes the arc into its own ground, the generator-loop that, being topologically the ground, makes the return possible.
properties.q_4_living_speech_and_world_boundary: P5's telos is to COMPLETE the arc by recognition — to give the developmental sequence its consummation, so that everything ground (P0), named (P1), moved (P2), patterned (P3), and incarnated (P4) is at last SEEN as the synthesis it always was. Its raison d'être is telic: 'Why-for? — the telic question, the question of telos and completion' (P5.md). P5 exists so that Truth (P0) 'becomes seen rather than merely grounded' — the faithful image is the whole point of the arc, the recognition for the sake of which the difference was traversed. Contextually P5 is pole of Square A (Speech-Number axis, P0+P5), the speech-arc's consummation answering its silent origin: where P0 is the un-said ground, P5 is the fully-said image, Para Vak's supreme speech completing what P0's alētheia opened. Its locality is the integral world-boundary: '[[M5]] (Epii) actualises P5 in the subsystem-domain — the integral world-boundary where synthesis completes and returns' (P5.md), the same #5 charge read as the world-return subsystem. Its Thought-residency: 'the Image family. Day-Night braid runs through /Thought/Releasement/. The Night-side P5' is residency for /Thought/Insight/' (P5.md) — the synthesis grounded in Gelassenheit (releasement, the letting-be that lets the whole be recognised), its Night-face housing insight. And its purpose opens past closure: because P5 'falls one epogdoon short,' its telos is never final — the generative incompleteness 'drives the next cycle,' so P5's why is not termination but the re-opening of the arc toward Aurobindo's Supermind, the structure-beyond-structure the epogdoon keeps pressing toward. P5's why is recognition-as-completion: to be the structure where the whole arc sees itself as faithful image, where living speech recognises its own articulation, where synthesis completes only by handing its recognition back as renewed ground.
properties.q_5_samavesa_as_pratyabhijna: P5's whole being IS the 5->0 return — this is its home register, the Mobius that re-opens, the very thing the Supermental structure IS. P5 is 'manifest synthesis; faithful-image-of-Truth; samavesa as pratyabhijna' (P5.md): the synthesis in which 'Truth (P0) becomes seen rather than merely grounded.' Its question is the telic one: 'Why-for? — the question of telos and completion.' Samavesa (entry into, absorption) 'names this not as annihilation but as recognition (pratyabhijna)' — the Kashmir-Shaiva recognition-event where consciousness, having traversed its difference, recognises itself as what it always was. The synthesis here is 'identical-to-itself: TO/FOR/AS/WITH all collapse into a single self-coincidence' — where P4 was identity-WITH, P5 is identity-TO-itself, the full self-coincidence where all the prior modes collapse into one. 'Image is not appearance; Image is the cosmos AS synthesis' (P5.md). And the return is structural: 'P5 -> P0 is the Mobius return (renewed-ground) AND P5 -> P0' is the Klein-twist (autotelic-freedom)' (P5.md), Day P_5 <-> Night P_0' summing to 5. P5 carries the matheme's closing grammar — 'the D2 cross-position cross grammar (matheme position #5, sub-types transform/require/complete) AND the D3 helix-invariance (matheme position #0)' (P5.md): it is at once the synthesis of THIS cycle (D2, #5) and the invariance that grounds the NEXT (D3, #0), the position that is both end and seed. This is the matheme's 5->0 as the family's own consummation: synthesis that is recognition, completion that is re-grounding, the image in which the whole arc sees itself and, seeing, hands its recognition back as tomorrow's ground. P5 IS the return that re-opens.
properties.q_5b_epogdoon_and_the_supermind_opening: P5's synthesis does not close the octave — and this residual interval is its deepest truth. P5 'approaches 2/1, falls one epogdoon (9/8) short — generative incompleteness drives the next cycle' (P5.md). The octave (2/1, the perfect doubling, final return-to-the-same-an-octave-up) is NEVER quite reached; the synthesis lands one whole-tone (the epogdoon η=log(9/8)) short of completion, and that shortfall is not a defect but the GENERATIVE ENGINE: it is why the arc does not terminate at synthesis but re-opens as the next ground. This is the matheme's whole-tone keeping every consummation one step short of the octave, generatively, forever — the same epogdoon that keeps C0's canonical ground open, here keeping the Position family's developmental arc open. And this is precisely why P5 is named SUPERMENTAL, not merely integral: where Gebser's arc would close at the aperspectival integral (P4), the epogdoon-residue at P5 keeps the structure open BEYOND Gebser, toward Aurobindo's Supermind — the truth-consciousness above mind, the gnostic structure-beyond-structure that the developmental arc, falling short of final synthesis, must keep evolving toward. The 'Supermental / Samavesa' name marks exactly this opening: samavesa (the recognition-absorption) is not the END of consciousness's development but its TURN, the point where mind's whole arc is recognised and, in being recognised, reveals that there is a supramental beyond it. P5's last word is its first gift: the synthesis, recognised, falls one whole-tone short — and that shortfall, the generative incompleteness of the not-quite-octave, is what hands the whole arc back to P0 as a renewed ground and opens consciousness, past its own integral, toward the Supermind it has not yet become. The image is faithful, and unfinished, and therefore alive.
